title: Frequency of Overpayment Notices and Claim Run Withholdings (Network Participation Agreements)
content:
Under the **Network Participation Agreements**, an agreement paid by claim payments that keeps generating overpayments has more of each claim payment run withheld when Cascade continues a recovery.

**Schedule.** The run notice-frequency adjustment to the continuing run withholding share is set by the agreement's overpayment notices dated fewer than 12 whole months before today:

| Notices in the window | Share points added |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 5 |
| 3 or more but fewer than 5 | 3 |
| Fewer than 3 | Nothing |

## Counting

- Count every overpayment notice on the agreement whose notice date is fewer than 12 whole months before today.
- Whole months are the difference in calendar months from the notice date to today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the notice date's day of the month.
- A notice counts whatever has since happened to it: refunded, withheld, reduced or still open.

## Hypothetical cases

- Four notices in the last 11 whole months: 3 points.
- Five notices: 5 points.
- Two notices in the window and three older ones: nothing.
